title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Detect and manage insider risk — with privacy and HR/legal guardrails
problem: The riskiest data movement often comes from inside — departing employees, inadvertent leaks, policy violations. This solution implements Insider Risk Management in Purview: the policy templates (data theft by departing users, leaks, policy violations), indicators and triggers, the connectors (HR, physical access) where used, alert triage and case management, and the privacy guardrails (pseudonymization, role separation) — configured with HR/legal so insider risk is detected and handled responsibly.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — Insider Risk policy templates, indicators/triggers, connectors, alerts→cases, the privacy-by-design controls, and the HR/legal engagement model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (E5/E5 Compliance, the Insider Risk roles + strict role separation, HR/legal/privacy stakeholders, connectors).

Implementation Guide — configure privacy settings + roles, build policies from templates, set indicators/triggers, wire connectors, tune alerts, and operate case management — pilot-first; case actions/HR outcomes deferred to HR/legal.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (policies detecting, alerts triaged, privacy controls on) plus Best Practices; investigative and disciplinary determinations remain with HR/legal.
short: Implement Insider Risk Management — policy templates, indicators/triggers, connectors, alert triage + case management, and the privacy guardrails — so insider risk is detected and handled responsibly with HR/legal. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.

bottom_line: Insider risk detected and handled responsibly — policies tuned, alerts triaged into cases, privacy-by-design enforced, HR/legal in the loop — the inside threat managed without overreach.
